data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net release of GBP 18.0m in prior year provisions in 2014. This release was driven by favorable claims development from portfolio re-balancing, quality improvement initiatives, and improved attritional loss experience, particularly in the Property division. However, the General Liability class required reserve strengthening due to disappointing loss experience and restructuring. The 2012 year of account closed with a profit despite being impacted by Super storm Sandy. The syndicate also experienced large loss activity in the Energy division in 2013 and Aviation war losses, including the Tripoli Airport attack, in 2014.
